name: Evergreen Max Cash Capital Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；公告主要涉及季度业绩、股息派发、股份拆细/附加上市、股东大会及关联交易授权续期等常规企业活动。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of any business segment in its announcements; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend payments, share subdivision/additional listing, general meetings, and renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.
